topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture and outlines its focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: PAMPs, DAMPs, and pathogen sensing principles
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular criteria that allow the innate immune system to identify infections and cellular damage while distinguishing self from non-self.

topics.label: Pattern recognition receptors and intracellular signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the major families of germline-encoded pattern recognition receptors and the downstream signaling cascades that coordinate inflammatory gene expression.

topics.label: Cellular recruitment, trafficking, and systemic inflammatory responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace the physiological cellular events of inflammation from sentinel cell activation and leukocyte extravasation to systemic cytokine outcomes.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic inflammatory adaptations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how the body terminates acute inflammation, restores damaged tissue, and manages persistent insults through chronic containment.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming topic on the complement system.
